name: Reconnaissance & OSINT
tagline: Passive + active discovery: subdomains, DNS, historical data, people, leaks, and exposed assets.

tools.name: crt.sh
tools.desc: Search engine over public Certificate Transparency logs; finds every subdomain that ever appeared in an issued TLS certificate.
tools.when: Zero-setup first pass: instant historical subdomain list from issued certificates, no API keys required.

tools.name: Cert Spotter
tools.desc: SSLMate's certificate-transparency monitor with a JSON API; returns certificate-linked subdomains plus issuance history.
tools.when: Watch a domain for newly issued certificates over time and script the subdomain results.

tools.name: Subfinder
tools.desc: Fast passive subdomain discovery from 25+ sources (certificates, DNS, archives, APIs); runs well keyless and better with free API keys.
tools.when: The daily driver for breadth: batch-enumerate subdomains from many passive sources in seconds.

tools.name: Chaos
tools.desc: ProjectDiscovery's continuously updated subdomain dataset fed by bug-bounty programs, queried through the chaos-client CLI.
tools.when: Pull an up-to-date subdomain dataset for a listed asset instead of brute-forcing from scratch.

tools.name: VirusTotal
tools.desc: Huge passive-DNS and resolution graph; the domain 'Relations' tab exposes related hosts, resolutions, and SSL-cert domains.
tools.when: Correlate a domain's infrastructure graph and pull historical resolutions when an API key is at hand.

tools.name: Puredns
tools.desc: Pipeline-focused brute-forcer that mass-resolves candidates through validated public resolvers and filters wildcard responses automatically.
tools.when: Run a strong wordlist through trusted resolvers when you only want real, wildcard-free hits as pipeline output.

tools.name: Gobuster
tools.desc: Multi-mode brute-forcer whose DNS mode guesses subdomains from a wordlist and resolves each candidate.
tools.when: Quick DNS wordlist run when full resolver management is overkill for the scope.

tools.name: altdns
tools.desc: Generates wordlist-based permutations of known subdomains (prefixes, suffixes, number swaps) to rediscover forgotten hosts.
tools.when: Expand an existing host list into thousands of plausible neighbor names before resolving.
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/infosec-au/altdns && cd altdns && pip3 install -r requirements.txt

tools.name: dnsgen
tools.desc: Pipes known domains through smart permutation rules (word insertion, affixing, number manipulation) to produce candidate subdomains.
tools.when: Compose with massdns (cat list | dnsgen - | massdns) for a fast generate-then-resolve enumerator.

tools.name: Amass
tools.desc: OWASP's one-stop subdomain engine: passive source scraping plus active brute forcing woven into an asset relationship graph.
tools.when: Long-running, full-scope enumeration where breadth and cross-asset correlation matter most.

tools.name: dnsx
tools.desc: High-performance DNS toolkit that resolves thousands of candidates and returns A/AAAA/CNAME/TXT with wildcard filtering.
tools.when: Filter a huge candidate list down to live hosts and fetch their records in a single pass.

tools.name: massdns
tools.desc: Extremely fast bulk resolver built to validate millions of candidates over UDP against a list of public resolvers.
tools.when: Feed permutation output at internet scale when normal resolver throughput rate-limits you.
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/blechschmidt/massdns && cd massdns && make

tools.name: grainrecon
tools.desc: Automated recon / attack-surface mapper — subdomains, DNS, port/service, tech-detect, CIDR inventory, OSINT, dir fuzzing.
tools.when: Building a full attack-surface map of assets you are authorized to test.

tools.name: dig
tools.desc: BIND's universal DNS interrogation client: any record type, AXFR/IXFR zone transfer attempts, and scripting-friendly output.
tools.when: Verify individual records and try authorized zone transfers on targets you are cleared to test.

tools.name: DNSRecon
tools.desc: Python DNS recon kit: standard records, cache snooping, wildcard testing, brute force, and AXFR checks in one pass.
tools.when: Automate the full DNS interrogation checklist on a scope where hand-rolled dig commands get tedious.

tools.name: dnstwist
tools.desc: Permutation engine for typo-squatting and homograph lookalikes of a domain; resolves each variant to flag impersonation risk.
tools.when: Authorized brand-protection reviews: find lookalike domains that could phish or impersonate your organization.
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/elceef/dnstwist && cd dnstwist && make all

tools.name: WHOIS
tools.desc: Standard registrar/registry client returning registration, owner, and nameserver records for domains and IP blocks.
tools.when: Pull registration dates and registrant metadata for a domain or range during authorized investigations.

tools.name: RDAP
tools.desc: openrdap's Go client for the modern RDAP protocol: structured JSON instead of loose text, with paging and entity linking.
tools.when: Script structured WHOIS-like lookups and follow registrant/registrar entities programmatically.

tools.name: ViewDNS.info
tools.desc: Free web aggregator for historical DNS, reverse IP, IP history, ASN/netblock maps, and WHOIS, with no API key.
tools.when: Cross-check old IPs, nameservers, or reverse lookups without pulling out heavy tooling.

tools.name: SecurityTrails
tools.desc: Full passive-DNS history plus subdomain and associated-domain APIs; the free tier works without keys.
tools.when: Reconstruct a domain's historical IP infrastructure to find withdrawn dev or staging servers.

tools.name: DNSDumpster
tools.desc: Visual subdomain, MX, and hostname map with optional on-page screenshots of discovered hosts.
tools.when: A graphical first look at a domain's DNS layout without signing up for anything.

tools.name: Rapid7 Open Data
tools.desc: Massive historical forward-DNS, reverse-DNS, and SSL scan datasets published as downloadable snapshots.
tools.when: Power offline historical enumeration across full internet snapshots with your own tooling.

tools.name: Wayback Machine
tools.desc: Internet Archive's snapshot library exposing old pages, removed endpoints, and historical response bodies for any URL.
tools.when: Recover deleted pages or inspect the evolution of login/config URLs during authorized historical research.

tools.name: urlscan.io
tools.desc: Renders and archives pages with full DOM, request log, and IP metadata; searchable by domain across every scan.
tools.when: See what a page actually loaded (networks, frameworks, subresources) without touching the target yourself.

tools.name: naabu
tools.desc: ProjectDiscovery's fast SYN scanner sweeping the top-N ports and handing live hosts to httpx/nuclei.
tools.when: Broad-but-quick port sweep across a large host list as pipeline input.

tools.name: masscan
tools.desc: Internet-scale SYN scanner (millions of packets/sec) that emits results in a format nmap can consume.
tools.when: Full-CIDR or internet-range sweeps when naabu's port sets are too small.

tools.name: RustScan
tools.desc: Sweeps all 65,535 ports in seconds and auto-pipes open ports into nmap service detection.
tools.when: Complete all-port coverage with minimal effort, letting nmap take over the fine details.

tools.name: Nmap
tools.desc: The canonical suite: stealth/connect scans, OS and service fingerprinting, version detection, and the NSE scripting engine.
tools.when: Deep service identification and low-rate version scans on a focused host set.

tools.name: httpx
tools.desc: Probes host lists for live web services, returning status, title, tech, CDN, and TLS fingerprints in one pass.
tools.when: Turn DNS/noise results into a clean inventory of live, web-facing hosts.

tools.name: WhatWeb
tools.desc: Signature-based fingerprint scanner matching headers, cookies, and HTML against 1,800+ technology definitions.
tools.when: Per-URL technology attribution across a moderately sized authorized target list.

tools.name: Retire.js
tools.desc: Scans page JavaScript for known-vulnerable library versions using DOM signatures.
tools.when: Fingerprint front-end dependencies and their exact versions on pages you are authorized to review.

tools.name: wafw00f
tools.desc: Sends harmless, identifiable probes to classify which WAF (if any) fronts a site, with vendor-specific signatures.
tools.when: Understand a target's defensive layer before deeper authorized testing.

tools.name: Feroxbuster
tools.desc: Rust-based recursive content discovery with smart filtering, auto-tuning, and server-config thesaurus support.
tools.when: Recursive directory/file brute force that stays fast on large authorized targets.

tools.name: dirsearch
tools.desc: Python content scanner with a large bundled dictionary, recursion, and multiple filter options.
tools.when: Quick wordlist-driven directory hunting with minimal setup.
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/maurosoria/dirsearch && cd dirsearch && python3 dirsearch.py

tools.name: ffuf
tools.desc: Blazing-fast Go fuzzer for directories, virtual hosts, parameters, and headers via FUZZ placeholders.
tools.when: Flexible content, vhost, or parameter fuzzing where wordlists and matcher filters need fine control.

tools.name: Katana
tools.desc: ProjectDiscovery's crawler with headless and standard modes, strict scope control, and JS-rendered page crawling.
tools.when: Deep crawl restricted to in-scope hosts while capturing files, parameters, and tech hints.

tools.name: gospider
tools.desc: Crawler focused on discovering subdomains, paths, buckets, and endpoints across seed URLs, with optional JS scraping.
tools.when: Link newly found subdomains to their content and gather link graphs across many seeds.

tools.name: hakrawler
tools.desc: Simple, fast link-crawler emitting unique URLs, forms, and script references from the pages it visits.
tools.when: A lightweight URL harvest with zero configuration before heavier crawling kicks in.

tools.name: LinkFinder
tools.desc: Regex and JS-parser-based endpoint miner that extracts URLs and hidden API paths from JavaScript bundles.
tools.when: Map the API surface hidden inside a site's JavaScript bundles.
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/GerbenJavado/LinkFinder && cd LinkFinder && pip3 install -r requirements.txt

tools.name: SecretFinder
tools.desc: Scans JS files for hardcoded keys, tokens, and credentials using cloud/API-specific signature patterns.
tools.when: Authorized audits: surface API keys or credentials accidentally shipped in client-side bundles.
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/m4ll0k/SecretFinder && cd SecretFinder && pip3 install -r requirements.txt

tools.name: Shodan
tools.desc: The canonical search engine for exposed services: banners, ports, TLS certs, and device fingerprints across the internet.
tools.when: Find every internet-facing service an organization exposes, by banner, org, or certificate query.

tools.name: Censys
tools.desc: Continuous internet-scan dataset with faceted search over hosts, certificates, and services, plus ASN/hosting attribution.
tools.when: Correlate exposed services with certificates and hosting metadata at scale.

tools.name: FOFA
tools.desc: Cyberspace search engine indexing services, assets, and applications with powerful expression-based queries.
tools.when: Get an overlapping, independent view of your exposed asset surface from different data sources.

tools.name: BuiltWith
tools.desc: Maps the technology stack of any site and can reverse-search for other sites sharing the same tech footprint.
tools.when: Per-URL tech attribution and finding related deployments through shared vendor footprints.

tools.name: PublicWWW
tools.desc: Source-code search engine matching any snippet (analytics IDs, tracking pixels, specific JS) across indexed sites.
tools.when: Find other properties sharing the same tracking or CDN code to expand the authorized asset footprint.

tools.name: Sherlock
tools.desc: Checks 400+ sites for a username in seconds and maps social/forum presences back to one identity.
tools.when: Correlate an individual's handle across platforms during authorized persona research.

tools.name: WhatsMyName
tools.desc: Open-source username-presence database with auditable per-service detection patterns.
tools.when: When you need a maintained, inspectable detection database you can extend for niche platforms.

tools.name: theHarvester
tools.desc: Multipurpose passive gatherer of emails, subdomains, hosts, and employee names from search engines, PGP, and GitHub.
tools.when: First-pass sweep that combines the human and asset surface in a single command.
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/laramies/theHarvester && cd theHarvester && pip3 install -r requirements.txt

tools.name: Hunter.io
tools.desc: Web and API domain email finder with address patterns, verification, and per-domain counts (rate-limited free tier).
tools.when: Discover and verify an organization's email address pattern during authorized intel gathering.

tools.name: holehe
tools.desc: Checks whether an email address is registered on hundreds of online services without sending any mail.
tools.when: Map which platforms an address is active on during an authorized investigation, minding service rate limits.

tools.name: Have I Been Pwned
tools.desc: Canonical breach-correlation service checking emails and password ranges against aggregated breached datasets.
tools.when: Identify which breaches an address appears in via the authenticated API during incident response.

tools.name: DeHashed
tools.desc: Searchable breach database with rich filtering by username, email, IP, and password hash.
tools.when: Structured correlation across breaches with exportable results for authorized investigations.

tools.name: Intelligence X
tools.desc: Search engine for documents, leaks, dark-web content, PGP keys, and historical web data, with a public API.
tools.when: Broadly triangulate a domain, email, or identity across leaks and scraped datasets.

tools.name: asnmap
tools.desc: ProjectDiscovery CLI mapping domains/IPs to ASNs and returning organization plus CIDR blocks from multiple sources.
tools.when: Expand scope correctly by pulling every org-owned netblock for a target.

tools.name: bgp.he.net
tools.desc: Hurricane Electric's BGP board showing ASN graphs, prefix announcements, and peering for any network.
tools.when: Visualize an organization's routing footprint, upstreams, and IPv4/IPv6 prefixes.

tools.name: ipinfo.io
tools.desc: IP metadata API providing geolocation, ASN, organization, hosting/cloud detection, and per-range domain lists.
tools.when: Attach location and hosting context to discovered IPs and enrich bulk results from the CLI.
